dialogues.jp: 「終わった……」
dialogues.en: "It's over..."
dialogues.text: "It's over..."

dialogues.jp: 「燃え尽きちまったよ……真っ白な灰に……」
dialogues.en: "Burnt up... into pieces of ash..."
dialogues.text: "Burnt up... into pieces of ash..."

dialogues.jp: 卒業証書が入った筒を、ぐっと握りしめる。
dialogues.en: I gripped my graduation certificate tightly.
dialogues.text: I gripped my graduation certificate tightly.

dialogues.jp: 「俺の素晴らしき３年間よ……さらば……」
dialogues.en: "My wonderful three years... farewell..."
dialogues.text: "My wonderful three years... farewell..."

dialogues.jp: 「実感が湧かねえぞコノヤロウ」
dialogues.en: "Show your true feelings already, you bastard."
dialogues.text: "Show your true feelings already, you bastard."

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「え？　な、何ですか、急に……」
dialogues.en: "W, what are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "W, what are you talking about?"

dialogues.jp:
たまたま通りかかったモヤシのような男子学生
に、｛ししど／宍戸｝｛ばいけん／梅軒｝の鎌のごとく絡みつく。
dialogues.en:
A passing student somehow got entwined in my monologue, like
a poor sap into Shishido Baiken's scythe.
dialogues.text:
A passing student somehow got entwined in my monologue, like
a poor sap into Shishido Baiken's scythe.

dialogues.jp:
ぱたぱたと走り去る背中を見つめながら、思わ
ずため息をもらした。
dialogues.en:
As I watched the back of the guy running away, I gave a
sigh.
dialogues.text:
As I watched the back of the guy running away, I gave a
sigh.

dialogues.jp: それなりに楽しかった３年間。
dialogues.en: It was an enoyable three years.
dialogues.text: It was an enoyable three years.

dialogues.jp:
それなりの量の思い出が胸に去来したりして、
思わず｛まぶた／瞼｝が熱くなったりもした。
dialogues.en:
Thinking about all the memories I have of this time was
enough to get my eyebrows heated up.
dialogues.text:
Thinking about all the memories I have of this time was
enough to get my eyebrows heated up.

dialogues.jp:
これからまたまた、見飽きた風見学園にお世話
になるのか……。
dialogues.en:
I'd still have to stare at this scenery of Kazami Academy
again soon...
dialogues.text:
I'd still have to stare at this scenery of Kazami Academy
again soon...

dialogues.jp: 「やるせねえなあ……」
dialogues.en: "It's despressing..."
dialogues.text: "It's despressing..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「やるせないですよねえ……」
dialogues.en: "Yeah it is..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah it is..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ぬおっ」
dialogues.en: "Wha?!"
dialogues.text: "Wha?!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「３年間、お疲れさまでした。朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Congratulations for the three years, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Congratulations for the three years, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「お、おう。いや、ことりもお疲れさま」
dialogues.en: "O, oh. Yes, you too."
dialogues.text: "O, oh. Yes, you too."

dialogues.jp: 唐突に現れたことりに、何とか｛どうき／動悸｝を整える。
dialogues.en:
At Kotori's sudden appearance, my pulse suddenly stared
racing.
dialogues.text:
At Kotori's sudden appearance, my pulse suddenly stared
racing.

dialogues.jp:
「んでも、やるせないって何が？　せっかくの、
　卒業式＆卒パだってのに」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, what's depressing? It IS the long-awaited
graduation ceremony and party..."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, what's depressing? It IS the long-awaited
graduation ceremony and party..."

dialogues.jp:
工事現場のライトのように、証書の入った筒を
ぱたぱた振る。
dialogues.en:
Pointing to the work being done outside using my graduation
certificate.
dialogues.text:
Pointing to the work being done outside using my graduation
certificate.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だって、ほら──」
dialogues.en: "Because of that--"
dialogues.text: "Because of that--"

dialogues.jp:
嫌でも視線がぶつかる、廊下でたむろする学生
達を指差す。
dialogues.en:
With a depressed look on her face, she pointed to several
students loitering in a corridor.
dialogues.text:
With a depressed look on her face, she pointed to several
students loitering in a corridor.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「さっきまでシクシク〜だった在学生が、今は
　もう笑ってるんだもん」
dialogues.en:
"Those students who were shedding so many tears just now are
laughing again."
dialogues.text:
"Those students who were shedding so many tears just now are
laughing again."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああ……泣いたカラスがもう笑うってやつだ
　な」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, when those who exhaust all their tears and start
laughing?"
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, when those who exhaust all their tears and start
laughing?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうそう、それです」
dialogues.en: "Yes yes, that."
dialogues.text: "Yes yes, that."

dialogues.jp:
思わず、ことりの顔に見入ってしまう。そんな
言葉が口を衝いて出た理由が、瞬時に分かった。
dialogues.en:
I looked at Kotori bewildered for a moment, then in an
instant, I realized what she was trying to say.
dialogues.text:
I looked at Kotori bewildered for a moment, then in an
instant, I realized what she was trying to say.

dialogues.jp: 泣いていた子ども──。
dialogues.en: When a kid crys--
dialogues.text: When a kid crys--

dialogues.jp: 和菓子を食べて、すぐに笑った──。
dialogues.en:
Then right after you give him sweets to eat, he laughs
again--.
dialogues.text:
Then right after you give him sweets to eat, he laughs
again--.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ねえ、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
凧のように飛び立っていた意識を、すぐさま巻
き戻す。
dialogues.en:
My mind, which was flying like a kite, quickly returned back
to earth.
dialogues.text:
My mind, which was flying like a kite, quickly returned back
to earth.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「もうすぐですよ」
dialogues.en: "It's coming soon."
dialogues.text: "It's coming soon."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……え？　そうだっけか？」
dialogues.en: "...Eh? It is?"
dialogues.text: "...Eh? It is?"

dialogues.jp:
パンフを開く。確か、ことり達の演奏は、もっ
と後だったはず……。
dialogues.en:
I opened the pamphlet for the graduation party. I thought
the trio's performance was quite a bit later.
dialogues.text:
I opened the pamphlet for the graduation party. I thought
the trio's performance was quite a bit later.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「違います。手芸部主催の──」
dialogues.en: "No no. I mean the handicraft club's--"
dialogues.text: "No no. I mean the handicraft club's--"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、ここに居たんですね。兄さんに、白河
　さ──ことり」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, here you are. Brother, and Shirkawa-sa...Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, here you are. Brother, and Shirkawa-sa...Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「卒業おめでとさんです♪　音夢」
dialogues.en: "Congratulations on your graduation, Nemu♪"
dialogues.text: "Congratulations on your graduation, Nemu♪"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、うん、おめでとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Ah, uhn, congratulations to you as well."
dialogues.text: "Ah, uhn, congratulations to you as well."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どうかしたのか、音夢？　俺は何もやってな
　いぞ？」
dialogues.en: "What's up, Nemu? What've I done now?"
dialogues.text: "What's up, Nemu? What've I done now?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そういう、犯罪者と刑事みたいな応答はしな
　いでくれます？　せっかくの、晴れの卒業式
　だというのに……」
dialogues.en:
"Why are you answering like a criminal? Don't make me worry
too much about the graduation party events now..."
dialogues.text:
"Why are you answering like a criminal? Don't make me worry
too much about the graduation party events now..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「分かった分かった」
dialogues.en: "Okay, okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay, okay."

dialogues.jp: どうどうとなだめる。
dialogues.en: I tried to pacify her.
dialogues.text: I tried to pacify her.

dialogues.jp: 「で、何よ？」
dialogues.en: "So, what's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "So, what's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、その……聞いてないんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Brother, have you... heard lately?"
dialogues.text: "Brother, have you... heard lately?"

dialogues.jp: ちらちらとことりを窺いながら、音夢が言う。
dialogues.en: Taking a short glance at Kotori, she continued.
dialogues.text: Taking a short glance at Kotori, she continued.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「白──ことりが、手芸部主催のコンテストに
　出るって……」
dialogues.en:
"Shi--Kotori's entering the contest, sponsored by the
handicrafts club..."
dialogues.text:
"Shi--Kotori's entering the contest, sponsored by the
handicrafts club..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「おお、さすがに情報が早いな。さすがは風紀
　委員──」
dialogues.en:
"Ooh, your sources are quick. Just as expected from the
discplinary committee--"
dialogues.text:
"Ooh, your sources are quick. Just as expected from the
discplinary committee--"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「って、まさか、お前も出るのか？」
dialogues.en: "...Wait a minute, don't tell me you're entering too?"
dialogues.text: "...Wait a minute, don't tell me you're entering too?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「出ません」
dialogues.en: "Absolutely not."
dialogues.text: "Absolutely not."

dialogues.jp: ｛みけん／眉間｝を押さえつつ、音夢が即答する。
dialogues.en:
Her forehead wrinkling, Nemu responded in the negative
immediately.
dialogues.text:
Her forehead wrinkling, Nemu responded in the negative
immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「万難を排して、回避しましたからね。ほんと
　に、あんな恥ずかしい事……」
dialogues.en:
"No way, not ever again, over my dead body. Not that
embarassing thing..."
dialogues.text:
"No way, not ever again, over my dead body. Not that
embarassing thing..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「クリスマスのアレがそんなに辛かったのかぁ、
　音夢ぅ」
dialogues.en:
"...I didn't know you felt that badly about that Christmas,
Nemu."
dialogues.text:
"...I didn't know you felt that badly about that Christmas,
Nemu."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……一人部外者顔して、肩を叩かないでいた
　だけます？」
dialogues.en:
"...Of course an outsider wouldn't be able to, and shouldn't
pretend to pat my shoulder and understand."
dialogues.text:
"...Of course an outsider wouldn't be able to, and shouldn't
pretend to pat my shoulder and understand."

dialogues.jp: 額をぴくぴくさせながら、手の甲をつねる。
dialogues.en: She wiggled my hand off her shoulder.
dialogues.text: She wiggled my hand off her shoulder.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それで……いいんですか？　コンテスト……」
dialogues.en: "But anyway... is it really okay to enter the contest?"
dialogues.text: "But anyway... is it really okay to enter the contest?"

dialogues.jp:
懸念に満ちた視線を、俺とことりと、等分に送っ
てきた。
dialogues.en:
There was a surprising amount of worry on her face as she
constantly switched her gaze between the two of us.
dialogues.text:
There was a surprising amount of worry on her face as she
constantly switched her gaze between the two of us.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「仕方ないんです。これは、交換条件なんで」
dialogues.en: "It can't be helped. This was the bargaining chip."
dialogues.text: "It can't be helped. This was the bargaining chip."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「交換条件？」
dialogues.en: "Bargaining chip?"
dialogues.text: "Bargaining chip?"

dialogues.jp: ことりは事情を説明した。
dialogues.en: Kotori explained the situation.
dialogues.text: Kotori explained the situation.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「衣装を……」
dialogues.en: "So it's about the clothes..."
dialogues.text: "So it's about the clothes..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「しゃくに障りますけどね。でも、フィフティ
　フィフティです」
dialogues.en:
"It's irritating. But in the end, it's about give and take,
50-50."
dialogues.text:
"It's irritating. But in the end, it's about give and take,
50-50."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そういう事情があったんだったら……確かに、
　仕方ないですね……」
dialogues.en: "If that's how it is... I guess there's really no choice."
dialogues.text: "If that's how it is... I guess there's really no choice."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも、ありがとね、音夢」
dialogues.en: "Though, thank you Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Though, thank you Nemu."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「心配してくれて」
dialogues.en: "For your concern."
dialogues.text: "For your concern."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、あ、いや、私はその……」
dialogues.en: "Eh, ah, no, I wasn't.."
dialogues.text: "Eh, ah, no, I wasn't.."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうだっ。私、やりかけの仕事があったんで
　す。危ない危ない、忘れるところだった……」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, I almost forgot! I have unfinished business to settle!
I have to go now, busy busy..."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, I almost forgot! I have unfinished business to settle!
I have to go now, busy busy..."

dialogues.jp: おいおい音夢よ、棒読みだぜ？
dialogues.en: Oyoy Nemu, you sound like you're reading off a script.
dialogues.text: Oyoy Nemu, you sound like you're reading off a script.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そ、それじゃ、失礼しますね。ふたりとも」
dialogues.en: "I, if you will, excuse me, both of you."
dialogues.text: "I, if you will, excuse me, both of you."

dialogues.jp:
何とも分かりやすい少女は、ぱたぱたと廊下を
走り去っていった。
dialogues.en:
As always, the easy-to-read girl flusteredly ran down the
corridor.
dialogues.text:
As always, the easy-to-read girl flusteredly ran down the
corridor.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……いい人ですよね」
dialogues.en: "...She's a good person."
dialogues.text: "...She's a good person."

dialogues.jp:
そんな背中を見遣りながら、ことりが相好を崩
す。
dialogues.en: Watching her back, Kotori smiled.
dialogues.text: Watching her back, Kotori smiled.

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、な」
dialogues.en: "Pretty much."
dialogues.text: "Pretty much."

dialogues.jp:
俺も同じようにして見つめ、目尻が下がってし
まうのを抑える事が出来ない。
dialogues.en:
I looked at Nemu's back as well, surpressing the urge to
sneak a peek sideways.
dialogues.text:
I looked at Nemu's back as well, surpressing the urge to
sneak a peek sideways.

dialogues.jp: 「……ま、自慢の妹だよ」
dialogues.en: "...Well, I'm proud to have her as my sister."
dialogues.text: "...Well, I'm proud to have her as my sister."

dialogues.jp:
せっかくの卒業式だ。それくらい言っても、バ
チは当たらないだろう。
dialogues.en:
It is a graduation now. If I wasn't honest any other time,
now would be one where I should.
dialogues.text:
It is a graduation now. If I wasn't honest any other time,
now would be one where I should.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ふふ、少しだけ、妬けちゃいます」
dialogues.en: "Hehe, I'm a little envious."
dialogues.text: "Hehe, I'm a little envious."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いや、盛大に妬いてくれていいぜ？」
dialogues.en: "Aww, you mean it's not envy on a grand scale?"
dialogues.text: "Aww, you mean it's not envy on a grand scale?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それは遠慮します」
dialogues.en: "I have some restraint, thank you."
dialogues.text: "I have some restraint, thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あっ、もう時間ですよ。私達も行きましょ！」
dialogues.en: "Ah, it's already time! Let's go!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, it's already time! Let's go!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　お、俺も？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? M, me as well?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? M, me as well?"

dialogues.jp: ことりはびゅしっと親指を立てた。
dialogues.en: Kotori stuck her thumb out.
dialogues.text: Kotori stuck her thumb out.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「決まってます」
dialogues.en: "Of course!"
dialogues.text: "Of course!"

dialogues.jp: ◆卒業◆
dialogues.en: ◆Graduation◆
dialogues.text: ◆Graduation◆

dialogues.jp: 卒業である。
dialogues.en: The graduatation had came.
dialogues.text: The graduatation had came.

dialogues.jp:
と、ことりと出会がやって来た。例の手芸部主
催のコンテストはもうすぐで、俺にも見に来て
欲しいと言うのだが……。
dialogues.en:
I came across Kotori and Nemu along the way. The former
reminded me that the contest was coming soon, and wanted me
to go watch it...
dialogues.text:
I came across Kotori and Nemu along the way. The former
reminded me that the contest was coming soon, and wanted me
to go watch it...
